clientinvinteractions.button.merge.detai: Moves items the container already holds from your inventory into it.
clientinvinteractions.button.move_all.de: Moves everything from your inventory into the container.
clientinvinteractions.button.take_all.de: Moves everything from the container into your inventory.
clientinvinteractions.button.sort.detail: Merges partial stacks and orders the items.
clientinvinteractions.button.sort.sophis: Uses Sophisticated's own sort with this order.
clientinvinteractions.button.hotbar_excl: Hotbar excluded. Hold Ctrl to include it.
clientinvinteractions.sort.unsupported: This inventory can't be sorted client-side
clientinvinteractions.sort.interrupted: Sorting stopped: an item or slot didn't behave like a normal chest slot
clientinvinteractions.sort.needs_free_sl: Sorting needs one empty slot in this container
clientinvinteractions.sort_order.name: Name
clientinvinteractions.config.title: Client Inventory Interactions
clientinvinteractions.config.hover_hint: Hover an option to see what it does.
clientinvinteractions.config.merge_butto: Button that moves items the container already holds from your inventory into it.
clientinvinteractions.config.move_all_bu: Button that moves everything from your inventory into the container.
clientinvinteractions.config.take_all_bu: Button that moves everything from the container into your inventory.
clientinvinteractions.config.sort_contai: Button that sorts the container. Right-click it to change the sort order.
clientinvinteractions.config.sort_player: Button that sorts your inventory (not the hotbar). Right-click it to change the sort order.
clientinvinteractions.config.include_hot: Merge and Move All also move hotbar items. When off, hold Ctrl while clicking to include the hotbar once.
clientinvinteractions.config.middle_clic: Middle-click a slot to sort that side (the container or your inventory). Skipped on filled slots in creative so cloning still works. Separate from the Sort hotkey.
How sorting orders items. Count puts the most plentiful items first. Sophisticated storage has no Item ID order and uses Name instead.
clientinvinteractions.config.show_on_sop: On Sophisticated Storage and Backpacks screens, show these buttons and hide Sophisticated's own sort, sort-by and transfer buttons.
clientinvinteractions.config.debug_loggi: Logs what this mod does to latest.log, and the full cause of network disconnects to debug.log. Leave off for normal play.
